items.title: 波斯豹、亞美尼亞盤羊、塞凡湖鱒 葉里凡「動物變裝遊行」千人上街
items.summary: 10月25日中午，參加動物變裝遊行的學生在葉里凡的自由廣場集合，各校的看板與面具擠滿廣場。攝影：賴晁翔 10月25日中午，亞美尼亞首都葉里凡（Yerevan）國家歌劇院旁的自由廣場（Freedom Square）擠滿了戴著面具與動物裝扮的學生。

items.title: COP31 Covered: Green skills, youth voices and a just transition with no teeth?
items.summary: The sixth episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with LinkedIn’s Efrem Bycer on the growing green skills gap.

items.title: ‘Not a favour, an opportunity’: Why youth voices must shape COP31’s implementation era
items.summary: For COP31’s Children, Youth, Education and Skills Day, edie speaks to COP31 Presidency Youth Climate Champion Sally Higgins and The Gaia Initiative team about why young people must be treated as decision-makers rather than a box to tick, and what businesses and governments stand to gain by listening.

items.title: ESG Today: Week in Review
items.summary: This week in ESG news: Sustainable fund inflows hit highest level since 2024; Appeals court blocks Scope 3 and climate risk reporting in California’s new climate disclosure laws; Mercedes-Benz switches 2039 carbon neutral goal to 2049 net zero target; EU Commission releases draft sustainability reporting assurance standards; UK proposes new supply chain deforestation due diligence laws; Just Climate raises $540 million for agriculture decarbonization solutions fund; EBA pushes back sustainability reporting simplification for banks to 2028; BBVA’s sustainable finance activity jumps by more than 25%; Amazon launches carbon footprinting solution; RWE, KKR secure €17 billion for UK renewable energy projects, and more.
